summary.text: Todd Beard is a Republican state senator from District 23 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A safety trainer by occupation, he chairs the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Todd Beard graduated from Hazelton High School and has worked as a safety trainer.
He has been affiliated with the Knights of Columbus, the Moose Club and the Basin Kruzers, and his legislative biography lists him as married with two children.
Beard assumed office on December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
In 2025 he chairs the Senate Education Committee and the Correction and Revision of the Journal committee and serves on the Energy and Natural Resources Committee.
